_about: Draft step file for `mobley lumen run` (Mobley driving the estate's own Lumen browser). Prerequisite: a signed-in Product Hunt session in Lumen, either imported from Safari on this Mac (`mobley lumen import-safari-cookies producthunt.com`) or created by signing in inside the Lumen window itself (its WebKit store persists). Selectors below are the first-pass guesses for the submission form; the run stops at the first failed step and leaves a screenshot, after which the selectors get corrected against `mobley lumen elements`. The final Schedule/Submit click is deliberately absent: John reviews and submits.

fill: Match every spec line to the catalog page, with the citation

CutsheetX reads a door or hardware spec, finds the manufacturer's catalog variant, and hands you the match with a link to the source page. Try it with no account. Then the same project record flows through bids, takeoffs, submittals, proposals, meetings and a 3D twin.

steps.note: Topics, thumbnail, gallery, makers (Ron Helms, John Mobley, Andrew Miller) and the first comment follow once the live form's selectors are confirmed; schedule date is John's call.
